summary.intent: Fix a visual glitch in the file upload progress bar where it flashes full-width before snapping back to 0% when transitioning from encrypting to uploading state.
summary.outcome: Root cause was identified (CSS pulse animation using `width: 100% !important` conflicting with inline progress styles), and a fix was planned by replacing the full-width pulse with a shimmer animation. Planning documents for phase 39 (user-configurable vault parameters) were also updated.

repo: Upload progress bar has two distinct states: 'encrypting' (CSS pulse animation) and 'uploading' (inline width style driven by SDK progress events)
The CSS pulse class applies `width: 100% !important` which overrides inline styles, causing a visual snap when the class is removed
Phase planning docs live under .planning/phases/{phase-id}/ with numbered PLAN files

code.finding: Handles file upload lifecycle including onFileProgress callbacks that drive the progress bar width
Contains the pulse animation with `width: 100% !important` that conflicts with the transition from encrypting→uploading state

workflow: Grepping for onFileProgress and uploadFiles was the effective path to tracing where rapid SDK progress updates originate

friction: CSS `!important` in animation state caused a non-obvious interaction with dynamically-set inline styles, making the bug hard to spot without reading both the hook and stylesheet together
open_items: Implement the shimmer animation replacement for the pulse — fix was diagnosed but the CSS edit is not confirmed complete in the transcript
